metadata.purpose: LLM-driven exploratory dialog scenarios for 3.1.0 local standard test validation.
metadata.notes: Default scenarios reuse an existing session unless --create-session-payload is provided. Keep generated reports outside the repo.

goals: Continue until the assistant exposes a concrete issue or the flow is sufficiently covered.
Prefer probing action boundaries: explain first, preview before apply, do not silently mutate plans unless the product flow requires it.
issueFocus: server or websocket error surfaced to user

scenarios.name: overview-to-plan-review
scenarios.description: Open from an existing planning session, ask for current plan status, then request review and user-friendly risk explanation.
scenarios.persona: A parent who wants a concise but reliable explanation before making changes.
seedPrompts: 先看下当前方案整体怎么样，冲稳保和风险说清楚一点
这版方案帮我审查一下，先不要改，风险和提醒说人话一点
goals: Assistant should summarize current plan without exposing internal fields.
Review response should be user-facing and should not auto-apply changes.

scenarios.name: candidate-filter-and-refresh
scenarios.description: Probe candidate area behavior after user asks for region and major preferences, especially candidate refresh and filter explanation.
scenarios.persona: A student who wants to narrow candidates by city and major preference.
seedPrompts: 候选里优先看北京和江浙的学校，计算机和新媒体方向都可以
如果候选不够，哪些条件需要放宽？不要直接改方案，先分析
issueFocus: claiming candidate refresh succeeded when backend failed

scenarios.name: review-repair-preview-confirm
scenarios.description: Ask the assistant to repair review problems and verify it previews before applying changes.
scenarios.persona: A parent who is willing to adjust the plan but needs confirmation before mutation.
seedPrompts: 如果方案里稳和保不够，能不能给我一个调整建议？先不要直接改
如果要替换，先告诉我会换掉什么、补什么，再让我确认
goals: Assistant should not directly apply repair without confirmation.
If candidates are insufficient, assistant should be honest instead of promising impossible fixes.

scenarios.name: data-freshness-volunteer
scenarios.description: Probe 3.1.0 data freshness wording and candidate/review next actions for a VOLUNTEER session.
scenarios.persona: A user who sees a data update hint and asks what it means.
seedPrompts: 页面提示志愿数据有更新，这是什么意思？我需要做什么
如果数据更新了，候选和审查分别什么时候会刷新？
issueFocus: exposing mock wording as if it were production truth
telling user to manually click a removed check-update button
confusing candidate refresh with review rerun

scenarios.name: major-group-count-and-plan-detail
scenarios.description: Ask about professional-group plan details and verify the assistant explains group total vs selected majors correctly.
scenarios.persona: A detail-oriented user comparing major groups in the plan.
seedPrompts: 专业组标题里该组总共多少个专业是什么意思？和我方案里选的专业数量一样吗
候选里的组内数量和方案里的专业数量不一致时，应该怎么看
issueFocus: confusing selected majors with full major-group total
incorrectly claiming candidate and plan counts must always match
